metadata.title: Print 8 — Professional Printing
metadata.description: Print 8 offers business cards, menus, invitations, t-shirt printing, cups, bags, and personalized gift sets.

home.heroTitle: Professional printing for your business and events
home.heroSubtitle: Business cards, invitations, menus, and custom products — prepared and printed with care. Choose a ready-made design, enter your details, and order online. Pay on delivery.
home.whyQualityDesc: We use professional equipment and materials for lasting results.
home.whyCustomDesc: From business cards to gift sets — every project is tailored to you.
home.whyDeliveryDesc: Order online, pay when you receive your product.

services.title: Our services
services.subtitle: Complete printing solutions — from business cards to personalized gift sets.

business-cards.title: Business cards
business-cards.description: Professional business cards with high print quality, various materials and finishes.

restaurant-menus.title: Restaurant menus
restaurant-menus.description: Elegant menus for restaurants, cafés, and hotels — laminated or plastified.

laminating.title: Laminating
laminating.description: Protection and enhancement of documents, posters, and menus with professional laminating.

color-bw-printing.title: Color & B&W printing

plastification.title: Plastification
plastification.description: Long-lasting protection of your materials with quality plastification.

t-shirt-printing.title: T-shirt printing
t-shirt-printing.description: Custom t-shirt printing — perfect for events, promotions, and gifts.

cup-printing.title: Cup printing
cup-printing.description: Personalized cups and mugs — great for promo or gifts.

bag-printing.title: Bag printing
bag-printing.description: Branded bags for your business or event.

bookbinding.title: Bookbinding
bookbinding.description: Professional binding of documents, theses, catalogs, and books.

wedding-invitations.title: Wedding invitations
wedding-invitations.description: Elegant invitations for your special day — with personalized design.

birthday-invitations.title: Birthday invitations

gift-sets.title: Personalized gift sets
gift-sets.description: Complete gift sets with your brand or message.

about.title: About Print 8
about.subtitle: Your trusted partner for professional printing.
about.story: Print 8 is a company dedicated to high-quality printing and personalized products. With modern equipment and experience, we turn your ideas into reality — from simple business cards to complex gift sets.
about.missionText: To provide accessible, quality printing services with a focus on customer satisfaction and fast delivery.
about.qualityDesc: Every project gets our full attention.
about.trustDesc: Pay on delivery — no risk for you.

contact.title: Contact
contact.subtitle: Get in touch — we'll respond as soon as possible.
contact.name: Full name

payment.a: We work exclusively with payment on delivery. You order online and pay when you receive the product.

formats.q: What file formats do you accept?
formats.a: We accept PDF, JPG, and PNG. For best results, use at least 300 DPI.

delivery.a: Standard delivery is 3–5 business days. For urgent orders, contact us.

custom.q: Can I create my own design?
custom.a: Yes! Use our design studio or upload your file when ordering.

minimum.a: It depends on the service. Business cards minimum is 100 pieces, t-shirts — 1 piece.

checkout.title: Checkout
checkout.subtitle: Fill in your details. Payment is made on delivery.
checkout.codDesc: Pay for your products when they arrive.
checkout.uploadHint: Upload your designs (JPG, PNG, PDF — max 10MB)
